name: Put SQUID to Bed — Captain
source: KB: squid-on-board-binder / §4 Captain Boat Checklist — PUTTING SQUID TO BED
intro: End-of-day shutdown. Captain handles helm/foredeck/engines; mate handles wetdeck/head. Coordinate the dock hose handoff.

items.label: Adjust spring lines to return boat to overnight position

sop.title: Returning SQUID to Overnight Position
steps: Untie the stern line from the dock cleat
Walk the boat back along the dock until the bow is past the boarding steps
Re-tie the stern spring line to the aft dock cleat
Adjust the bow spring line so the boat sits 2–3 feet back from the boarding area
Verify the anchor is NOT hanging over or contacting the boarding steps
Check that fenders are positioned to protect the hull at the new position

items.label: Log trip in logbook — engine hours, guest counts, locations, sightings

help.title: Logbook entries
help.body: Record: final engine hours, trip guest counts, locations visited, sighting location(s), maintenance completed, and any notes for the next captain.

items.label: Complete daily maintenance if it wasn't done between trips

sections.title: Scrub & Rinse (dock hose)
sections.description: Captain is responsible for scrubbing and rinsing these areas with the dock hose.

items.label: Scrub and rinse helm area, foredeck, and stainless steel railings
Scrub and rinse house and gunwale back to snorkel door exits
Rinse hulls LAST — soapy water drips down and leaves film on paint

help.title: Why hulls last?
help.body: Soapy water from the foredeck will drip down and leave a film over time, ruining the paint job. Always rinse hulls after everything above is done.

items.label: Photo of deck/hull condition after rinse (optional)
items.placeholder: Document any staining, damage, or paint issues

sop.title: Engine Flushing Procedure
steps: Connect freshwater hose to the flush port on the engine
Turn on the water at the dock spigot — confirm flow
Start the engine and let it run at idle for 2 full minutes
Monitor the tell-tale (water stream from exhaust) to confirm water is flowing through
After 2 minutes, shut off the engine FIRST
Then turn off the water at the dock spigot
Disconnect the hose and repeat for the second engine

items.label: Rinse the bejeezus out of steering rams, tanks, motors
Hand dock hose over to mate (ensure mate completes their duties efficiently)
Plug shorepower in, flip switch on tower
Turn off all 12v switches except bilge pumps

help.title: How to verify charging
help.body: The multimeter on the 12v rocker panel should be at or above 13v. Visually confirm the Victron inverter has 2 lights on under the left side that says Charger: Mains on and either Bulk, Absorption, or Float.

items.label: Pass relevant information onto the next captain via text

completion.notes_prompt: Anything the next captain needs to know? Maintenance issues, engine concerns, guest feedback?
